change.summary: Serialize Netlink socket publication, use, and release so netlink_kernel_release cannot overlap an active netlink_unicast call.
details: A static mutex protects nl_sk. sendnlmsg holds it from the pointer/PID check through netlink_unicast and unlocks on every return path.
netlink_init publishes nl_sk while holding the mutex.
netlink_exit detaches nl_sk and calls netlink_kernel_release while holding the mutex, after existing senders have completed.
nl_data_ready uses READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE for pid shared with sendnlmsg.
change.unresolved_related_risk: This does not drain a panel callback already selected by the stock panel_event_notifier provider. A callback can still be executing module text after unregister returns; see lifetime_sync_panel_callback_race_20261111/audit.json.

observed: netlink_unicast uses the supplied sender socket in sock_sndtimeo and netlink_getsockbyportid.

call_context.irq_sender: gf_irq is registered as the threaded handler with request_threaded_irq(irq, NULL, gf_irq, IRQF_TRIGGER_RISING | IRQF_ONESHOT, ...).

display_sender.observed: The display callback is reached through _sde_kms_drm_check_dpms from the MSM DRM commit path; complete_commit executes in the commit kthread callback, with a synchronous fallback in commit context. These call paths support taking a mutex.

assembly_comparison.interpretation: The comparison correctly reports intentional assembly deviations caused by the new locking and access primitives. This is not stock-exact reconstruction and does not establish semantic correctness; the mappings remain pending independent review.
